sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def wblocks(fr):
    L = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    cells = [(r,c) for r in range(44,63) for c in range(10,38) if L[r][c]=='W']
    if not cells: return 0
    # cluster into 3x3 blocks
    rs=sorted(set(r for r,c in cells)); cs=sorted(set(c for r,c in cells))
    return len(cells)
def knob(fr):
    L = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    cells = [(r,c) for r in range(17,25) for c in range(18,46) if L[r][c] in 'bS']
    if not cells: return None
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    pat = ''.join('b' if L[r][c]=='b' else 'S' for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1))
    return (c0,c1,pat)

seq = ['RIGHT','RIGHT','RIGHT','RIGHT','UP','DOWN', {'action':'MOUSE','row':50,'col':30}]
res = action(seq)
print('done?', last_action_result.get('done'), 'level_completed?', last_action_result.get('level_completed'), 'game_over?', last_action_result.get('game_over'))
for i,t in enumerate(transitions[-7:]):
    a = t.action if isinstance(t.action,str) else str(t.action)
    print(a, '| knob:', knob(t.after_frame), '| Wcells:', wblocks(t.after_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def wblocks(fr):
    L = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    cells = [(r,c) for r in range(44,63) for c in range(10,38) if L[r][c]=='W']
    if not cells: return 0
    # cluster into 3x3 blocks
    rs=sorted(set(r for r,c in cells)); cs=sorted(set(c for r,c in cells))
    return len(cells)
def knob(fr):
    L = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    cells = [(r,c) for r in range(17,25) for c in range(18,46) if L[r][c] in 'bS']
    if not cells: return None
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    pat = ''.join('b' if L[r][c]=='b' else 'S' for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1))
    return (c0,c1,pat)
